size_tables.note: Speedway dropdown lists 2, 3-1/2, 4, 6 in radius; its Details text lists 3.5, 4, 5, 6 (conflict). Speedway #32118300.
JMD Mandrel Bends hub: stainless, aluminum, titanium and mild steel bends, 0.75 to 5 in OD; SS angles 15/45/90/120/135/180 plus U-J pipes and a .120 wall line; titanium 45/90/135.

Ticon Industries' 'Alucon Aluminum' collection shows 'Aluminum 45/90/180 Mandrel Bend - 6061' products; sizes, wall, CLR and part numbers were not visible. alucon.com / aluconmfg pages could not be reached or found.

notes: Scope per coordinator: Stainless Bros, Ticon, Cone, SPD, Stainless Headers Mfg and Ace Race Parts deliberately excluded; Vibrant 13051/13042 and the Vibrant aluminum parts already in the tool were not re-added.

JMD Tubes lists CLR for every SKU on its own site (jmdtubes.com) and its item numbers encode OD/CLR/angle (e.g. MB-SS-188300180 = 1-7/8 OD, 3.00 CLR, 180). Leg lengths are shown as '≈ 6"' (approximate); legs [6,6] are recorded but treat them as nominal.
JMD entries were read from category listing pages (seen_on field), the product URL is the link those listings give. Only MB-SS-188300180 was opened individually to confirm the listing data.

JMD category pages show only the first 48 items; the SS 180 page (48 shown) and SS 45 page (48 of 53) may have a few more SKUs not captured. Mild steel listing: only page 1 (19 header-size items) captured; 146 mild-steel bends exist.
JMD U-J pipes: listing data only had OD/CLR/SKU; titles are null where the exact title was not captured.
JMD titanium bends: wall thickness and grade not listed.
Vibrant data comes from retailers (Vibrant's own site was not reachable through search). Several retailers list only gauge (16 ga = .065, 18 ga = .049); wall is set from the stated gauge.
Vibrant 138xx 'Stainless Steel Mandrel Bend Piping' bends are 321 stainless (16 or 18 ga, 6x6 legs), not 304.
Vibrant 18xxx bends (e.g. 18182, 18383, 18794) generally list no wall or legs; 90s in that line show 4 x 12 tangents where stated.
Entries marked 'seen in a product grid on this Fidanza page' came from a related-products grid, not the URL's own product; title and part number were visible together.
Retailer SKUs with prefixes (VIB2697, VBR18684, VIB18795) are kept as shown; the Vibrant number is the numeric part.
Alucon: no verifiable bend listings found. alucon.com and aluconmfg returned nothing usable; Ticon's Alucon collection shows 6061 bends with no visible sizes.
For a 1.5D CLR, CLR in inches = 1.5 x OD; JMD and Vibrant both state CLR in inches directly, so no conversions were needed.
